title: NetZeroCities CESF Expert Support - Slovenia
description: As part of the NetZeroCities City Expert Support Facility programme, Climate KIC is looking for an expert support to facilitate the Community of Practice of cities in the Republic of Slovenia.
fit_reason: This tender requires city-facing community of practice facilitation for municipal net-zero transitions in Slovenia, which is unrelated to DevelopMinded's technology commercialisation and deep tech startup support services.
call_summary: This call is part of the NetZeroCities City Expert Support Facility (CESF) programme run by EIT Climate-KIC, seeking an expert to facilitate a Community of Practice among cities in Slovenia working toward net-zero goals. The contractor must deliver facilitation, coordination, and peer-learning support for Slovenian municipalities within the NetZeroCities network.

title: Request for proposal: Event Management Services for the Expert Forum: REE & Battery Materials on 2…
fit_reason: This tender requires an event management agency for physical event production, logistics, and on-site delivery — none of which are services DevelopMinded offers.
call_summary: EIT RawMaterials is seeking an experienced event agency to plan, coordinate, produce, and deliver the Expert Forum on REE & Battery Materials in Turin, Italy (2-5 November 2026) for approximately 200 participants. The contractor must handle all aspects of venue coordination, audiovisual production, branding, participant management, catering, and on-site operational delivery.

title: Request for Proposal: Event Management Services – Expert Forum: Green and Circular Metals on 29-30…
fit_reason: This tender requires event management and logistics services for a physical conference, which is entirely outside DevelopMinded's service portfolio of technology commercialisation, investment readiness, and strategic consultancy.
call_summary: EIT RawMaterials is seeking an experienced event agency to plan, coordinate, produce, and deliver the Expert Forum: Green and Circular Metals in Amsterdam on 29-30 September 2026, expected to host approximately 150 participants. The contractor must concretely deliver venue and logistics coordination, participant registration management, audiovisual and streaming production, on-site operations, and speaker support throughout the two-day event.
